briefings.title: Spencer Pratt on Fixing LA: Wildfires, Homelessness, Corruption & the Fight to Take It Back
briefings.tldr: Spencer Pratt is running for Mayor of Los Angeles on a platform of "radical accountability," proposing to end the city's homelessness and wildfire crises by enforcing existing laws, auditing the $25B "NGO industrial complex," and replacing career bureaucrats with $1-a-year private sector executives.
